identity_unique_subject.name: identity_unique_subject
identity_unique_subject.where: status = 'verified' AND provider_subject_hash IS NOT NULL

listing_unavailability_period_chk.name: listing_unavailability_period_chk
listing_unavailability_period_chk.value: NOT isempty("listing_unavailability"."period") AND lower("listing_unavailability"."period") IS NOT NULL AND upper("listing_unavailability"."period") IS NOT NULL

generated.as: CASE WHEN type = 'rent_out' AND declared_value_ore IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN declared_value_ore <= 500000 THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END END
setweight(to_tsvector('norwegian', coalesce(title, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('norwegian', coalesce(description, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(title, '')), 'C')

listings_money_nonneg.name: listings_money_nonneg
listings_money_nonneg.value: coalesce("listings"."price_ore", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("listings"."deposit_ore", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("listings"."budget_ore", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("listings"."delivery_fee_ore", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("listings"."declared_value_ore", 1) > 0

rent_out_requires_terms.name: rent_out_requires_terms
rent_out_requires_terms.value: "listings"."type" <> 'rent_out' OR "listings"."status" = 'draft' OR ("listings"."price_ore" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."price_unit" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."declared_value_ore" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."item_condition" IS NOT NULL)

deposit_not_above_value.name: deposit_not_above_value
deposit_not_above_value.value: "listings"."deposit_ore" IS NULL OR "listings"."declared_value_ore" IS NULL OR "listings"."deposit_ore" <= "listings"."declared_value_ore"

give_away_is_free.name: give_away_is_free
give_away_is_free.value: "listings"."type" <> 'give_away' OR ("listings"."price_ore" IS NULL AND "listings"."declared_value_ore" IS NULL AND "listings"."deposit_ore" IS NULL)

give_away_states_condition.name: give_away_states_condition
give_away_states_condition.value: "listings"."type" <> 'give_away' OR "listings"."status" = 'draft' OR ("listings"."known_defects" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."item_condition" IS NOT NULL)

wanted_has_no_item_terms.name: wanted_has_no_item_terms
wanted_has_no_item_terms.value: "listings"."type" <> 'wanted' OR ("listings"."declared_value_ore" IS NULL AND "listings"."deposit_ore" IS NULL AND "listings"."price_ore" IS NULL)

wanted_dates_ordered.name: wanted_dates_ordered
wanted_dates_ordered.value: "listings"."wanted_to" IS NULL OR "listings"."wanted_from" IS NULL OR "listings"."wanted_to" >= "listings"."wanted_from"

not_wanted_fields_only_on_wanted.name: not_wanted_fields_only_on_wanted
not_wanted_fields_only_on_wanted.value: "listings"."type" = 'wanted' OR ("listings"."wanted_from" IS NULL AND "listings"."wanted_to" IS NULL AND "listings"."budget_ore" IS NULL)

delivery_fields_need_delivery.name: delivery_fields_need_delivery
delivery_fields_need_delivery.value: "listings"."handover_owner_delivery" OR ("listings"."delivery_fee_ore" IS NULL AND "listings"."delivery_radius_km" IS NULL)
